hero.headline: Chandigarh Online MBA in Human Resource Management: Syllabus, Fees and Career Outcomes
hero.sub: UGC-DEB approved 2-year programme with Harvard and PwC certification options

sections.tldr: An HR specialisation with a strong analytics and automation component, naming Human Resource Analytics and AI in Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning alongside compensation and performance management. Chandigarh University, NIRF Management #32, NAAC A+.

about.body:
HR is splitting into two jobs: the one that runs processes and the one that sits in the room when the headcount decision gets made. The second increasingly requires numbers, and this syllabus is built for it.

The subjects are Human Resource Analytics, Organisation Change and Development, AI in Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning, Compensation Management, Performance Management Systems and Strategies, and Methodology of Training and Development.

The analytics and AI pairing is the current part. Recruitment is one of the most heavily automated corporate functions now, and understanding what those systems optimise for is becoming part of the job rather than a technical aside.

Compensation Management is the most commercially useful subject in the set. Pay structure is the largest controllable cost in most service businesses and the decisions around it are frequently made without analysis.

Organisation Change and Development covers the part of HR that is hardest to teach: getting a restructure accepted rather than merely announced.

Two things are common to every Chandigarh specialisation and worth pricing separately from the subject list. AI for Managers appears in all of them, so the AI exposure is not unique to the technical tracks. And the programme runs in two tiers, where the higher tier bundles PwC co-taught modules and additional certification. Ask which tier your fee quote covers, because the subject list does not change between them.

Chandigarh University's NAAC A+ accreditation cycle carried a validity date of September 2026, so confirm the current grade at naac.gov.in before you rely on it.

Fees quoted here change between intakes. Confirm the current figure, which tier it buys, the early-bird terms and what sits outside the tuition with the university in writing before you pay.

subjects.name: Decision Science
subjects.description: Data-driven decision models applied to HR problems including attrition, hiring, and performance.

subjects.name: Human Resource Analytics
subjects.description: People data analysis, workforce metrics dashboards, attrition modelling, and HR ROI measurement.

subjects.name: Organisation Change & Development
subjects.description: Change management models, OD interventions, culture transformation, and managing resistance.

subjects.name: Compensation Management
subjects.description: Pay structure design, job evaluation, incentive schemes, and total rewards benchmarking.

subjects.name: Project Management
subjects.description: Project delivery frameworks applied to HR transformation initiatives and large-scale change programmes.

subjects.name: Performance Management: Systems and strategies
subjects.description: Goal-setting frameworks (OKR, BSC), appraisal design, and continuous feedback systems.

subjects.name: Methodology of Training and Development
subjects.description: Training needs analysis, instructional design, learning evaluation (Kirkpatrick), and L&D ROI.

syllabus.note: Subjects as listed in the university syllabus we hold. Universities revise subjects between intakes.

skills.body:
The outcome is being able to argue about people in the language the business uses.

Human Resource Analytics and Compensation Management do most of that work: attrition modelling, cost of replacement, pay band design and the arithmetic behind a reward structure. These are the subjects that let you answer a finance director rather than defer to one.

AI in Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning covers automated screening and capacity forecasting, including the bias and fairness questions that come with automating a hiring decision.

Performance Management Systems and Strategies covers goal setting, review design and the well-documented ways rating systems distort behaviour.

Methodology of Training and Development covers programme design and the harder question of measuring whether training changed anything. Organisation Change and Development covers restructuring, culture and the practicalities of a transition.

comparisons.body:
**vs Amity Online MBA HRM:** Amity is NAAC A+, NIRF Management #49, strong brand recognition in HR hiring for Delhi NCR corporates. For candidates targeting consulting-grade HR roles, CU Tier 2 is the stronger profile.

**vs NMIMS Online MBA HR:** NMIMS carries a strong brand in BFSI HR and Mumbai-area corporate hiring. NMIMS is the better brand choice for candidates targeting BFSI HR or Mumbai-based companies.

**vs Manipal Jaipur Online MBA HR:** MUJ has NAAC A+ and similar fee range. Neither has the other's specific industry partnership advantage. CU's PwC People and Organisation teaching is a clear differentiator for HR professionals targeting advisory, consulting, or analytics-led HR roles.

certificate.body:
Graduates receive a Chandigarh University MBA degree certificate with Human Resource Management noted on the marksheet, issued under UGC-DEB 2020 standards. The NIRF Management #32 and NAAC A+ credentials make this certificate effective in both private sector and PSU HR hiring where accreditation is a shortlisting criterion.

Tier 1 graduates receive the Harvard Business Publishing certificate. Tier 2 graduates additionally receive PwC People and Organisation co-teaching acknowledgement and CAPM preparation, strengthening profiles for HR consulting, people analytics, and OD roles. DigiLocker integration provides instant digital verification.

faqs.question: What is the PwC partnership in Chandigarh Online MBA?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University's premium tier includes full MBA modules co-created and co-taught by PwC industry experts. This is unmatched among Indian online MBAs - most offer only generic curriculum.

faqs.question: Does the Chandigarh Online MBA HRM prepare for SHRM or CIPD certifications?
faqs.answer: The MBA HRM curriculum covers content areas that overlap with SHRM-CP (talent acquisition, compensation, training) and CIPD Foundation Level (HR practice, employment law, L&D). The MBA does not automatically prepare you for the SHRM or CIPD exams, but it builds the foundational knowledge you would build on for those certifications. Many HR professionals pursue SHRM-CP or CIPD after their MBA once they have the work experience requirement.

faqs.question: Is the AI in Talent Acquisition subject relevant for current HR roles?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI in Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning covers AI-assisted sourcing, predictive hiring models, ATS optimisation, and bias-mitigation tools being actively deployed by mid-size to large organisations. Companies including TCS, Infosys, HDFC Bank, and Amazon India now use AI-assisted talent screening. This subject gives HR professionals practical familiarity with tools their employers are already using.

chooseIf: You want PwC-taught HR consulting and people analytics content (Tier 2) alongside your degree.
You are targeting HRBP, people analytics, or OD roles that value consulting-grade HR frameworks.
consider: You specifically need NMIMS brand recognition for BFSI HR or Mumbai corporate hiring.
You need SHRM or CIPD certification path guidance - a specialist HR institute may suit better alongside an MBA.
